observations: Photo 0: A stainless steel electric kettle with a black plastic handle and base, placed on artificial grass. The kettle has a visible power cord with a 3-pin plug. A small sticker is on the lid, but the text is not legible. The interior shows a heating element.
Photo 1: Same kettle from a slightly different angle, showing the spout and lid. The sticker on the lid is still unreadable. The kettle appears clean and intact.

Photo 2: Interior view showing the heating element inside the kettle. The element is coiled and appears to be made of metal. The kettle's interior is shiny and reflective, with some minor scratches. The power cord is visible again.

claims.claim: London used Home Plus 4.2L Electric Stainless Kettle
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The kettle may not be functional or may have internal damage to the heating element.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle being turned on and heating water, or a close-up of the heating element in operation.

risks.risk: The kettle may have hidden scratches or dents not visible in the photos, especially on the base or handle.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the base and handle from multiple angles, including under the kettle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having minor cosmetic damage

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying, cuts, or loose connections.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker on the kettle showing the brand and model.
Video of the kettle being turned on and heating water.
Close-up photos of the base and handle to check for scratches or dents.
Close-up of the power cord and plug to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
